title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Mobility layer base station's on the fritz, HR's trying to make me look through resumes, Logistics needs terminal upgrades, Warfarin wants me for Warfarin stuff… Doc, could you dim the office for me? I'm just taking five, then I'll be outta here… *yawn*…

title: Talk 1
original: If you think 'Procurement's gotta have special channels to buy all these kinds of snacks', you're right! Her Highness let me head it back when we were fixing up the old Rhodes, after I rustled up a whole cutting-edge Columbian full-auto assembly line for her. So keep our procurement magic alive—no haggling!

title: Talk 2
original: I used to butt heads with my folks for going 'ooh, you're a Vampire, act like it' at me, but these days? Knowing Warfarin, Entelechia—heck, Duq'arael? Makes me think that every Vampire is a neat-freak in some way. Still, that's their business. They try and suck my blood, all they'll get is coffee.

title: Talk 3
original: Sure, a chief engineer's gotta dabble in everything, but what's funnier? Welding, or making Lancet-2 call me 'lovely Ms. Closure'? That's right—hey, the 'lovely Ms.' part is NOT weird, don't get distracted. Don't you think giving a machine her own problems makes her even more human?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Kal'tsit's back, I wouldn't trade that for anything. But hello? She's back! Can everyone PLEASE stop going through me for Rhodes Island business now? I don't wanna run this place! I don't! At this rate, our next mission's gonna be Operation Rescue Closure From Hell After She Died of Overwork!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Before Her Highness dragged me outta the loft, no one expected this self-proclaimed member of Kazdel's Elite 100 would be reduced to an engineer, working year-round, no vacations. What? Nah, I'm not mad. Even if I could go back in time, I don't think I'd ever find anything as cool as what I'm doing now.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doc, what the hell's with your physical results? Huh? You're feeling how feeble lately?! …Not much longer for this land?! Hang in there, I'm gonna fund Medical with the years of money I wrung out of you. That's right, I never touched a cent—what? The results are fake? I fell for it? WARFARIIIN!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: It's good to be a little willful as a kid. I was, and now I'm the picture of mental health. But Amiya keeps everything bottled up inside, she's always forcing herself to be more mature. She grew up—but she grew up without ever knowing the luxury of being a kid first. Doesn't that tear you up inside?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: When I first met you, you struck me as a total enigma. After all these years, you've finally been decoded, only for it to unlock our greatest enemy… Hey, don't worry. Whatever happens, I'll be back in Engineering waiting to fix your hot water kettle, heheh.

title: Idle
original: You there? Yeah, yeah, Doctor's asleep. Bring any slow-moving product into the office, make it snappy. Let's see if I can't make a sales pitch or two…

title: Onboard
original: Bet you never thought I'd accept a field assignment, huh? Well, hey, Kal'tsit's back, Rhodes Island is rebuilt—now I finally get the chance to ditch work by going on one of these.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Wait, rewind a sec. Enhance. Who's that on the battlefield sneaking a bag of chips?

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Me? I don't have any more promotion track. What, am I Rhodes Island SUPER Chief Engineer?

title: Promotion 2
original: After all the people you've given this medal to, finally it's my turn. Look at how we designed these things to save on material. Gives me all sorts of feelings… Hey, no matter what, we've got a long road ahead of us, don't we?

title: Added to Squad
original: Drone prep complete. What's our T-minus to departure? Maybe I can catch up on some sleep…

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You want me for captain…? Screw it, I handle job titles ten times as exhausting as this. Squad captain's nothing. I'm on it!

title: Depart
original: Drone 6 has liftoff. Visibility clear… we're good to go.

title: Begin Operation
original: If Procurement got this many customers in a day, I'd be dreaming. Heck, I'd laugh myself awake…

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Let's hustle our bustles! Engineering's got a mountain of tasks waiting for me, and they're all more fun than a fight.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I wrote Procurement's number on your jacket. Someone'll pick up the phone while I'm not there!

title: Deployment 1
original: Zeroth Order Oil Tank is now gathering field intel!

title: Deployment 2
original: Real-time data sharing is a go. Perk your ears up, people!

title: In Battle 1
original: Don't miss today's special offer! We got—uh, bombs and that's it.

title: In Battle 2
original: No coupon flyers up ahead, only crossfire!

title: In Battle 3
original: Can I reprogram your brain a sec and make you turn tail? That's compassion, I guess, right?

title: In Battle 4
original: Uh oh, feeling that screen sickness… Chocolate, chocolate…

title: 4-star Result
original: Area swept out, no casualties on our side, only slight waste in expenditure… You've really outdone yourself, Doc. Can you also do that back home? We would LOVE it at Engineering if you did!

title: 3-star Result
original: Hey, Doc, look how good everyone did! Better procure a little reward for them, don't you think?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I've got a covert tracker on the enemies who slipped past, but… hey, if they're not coming back, works for me.

title: Operation Failure
original: All drones, release hooks, uncap output, latch onto the Doctor's hood—and liftoff!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Hm? Why bring me here? What, you wanna buy some new decor for this place?

title: Tap
original: Don't rush me, I'm still adding these up.

title: Trust Tap
original: Grilled flavor biscuit. Want one?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doc, we're not gonna talk business OR work today! We spent the whole year grinding for Rhodes Island, so now we relax for the day! Was that my comm? Hold on, lemme take this—what? A malfunction? Where…? Dooooc, can you come with me for this…?

title: Greeting
original: Here, coffee. I see those bags under your eyes. Another all-nighter, huh?

title: Birthday
original: All Rhodes Island operators get a shot at a voucher for free Procurement goods on their birthdays, and you're no exception! Come up and draw! The voucher's waiting for you in the special prize! What? Who's drawn the special prize before? I, uh—don't worry about it, maybe you'll be the first!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: If we're counting, then this is the third time I've 'fixed up' Rhodes Island, right? Shouldn't say I'm used to it by now, but after everything we've been through, I'll go out on a limb and say that no hardship will knock down genius engineer Closure, and nothing can take out Rhodes Island! Wherever we all are, that's Rhodes.
